task: Add a 'student' membership tier with base fee 20 to renewal.py. The student tier participates in every existing status branch exactly as basic and gold do: an active member renews for the base fee; a lapsed member within the grace period renews for base fee plus the existing late fee, and beyond the grace period is reinstated for base fee plus the existing reinstatement surcharge; a suspended member below the strike limit reactivates for 150% of the base fee (rounded down), using the same formula already applied to basic and gold. All existing validation order, error messages, and payment-method handling apply unchanged to student-tier members. Keep process_renewal's signature and every existing tier's and status's behavior unchanged.
